title: Uniform output of random bit vectors
statement: Let $n$ and $b$ be natural numbers, and let $f:\{−1,1\}^{n}\to\{−1,1\}$ be a Boolean function. Running the program that generates $b$ independent unbiased bits and records its work cost gives the uniform distribution on vectors in $\{0,1\}^{b}$, paired with the fixed cost $(0,0,b)$ (zero random examples, zero queries, and $b$ units of work).
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
Natural number number of generated bits $b$
